selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations, particularly after the CD4 count began to improve, are more closely aligned with Kaposi's sarcoma, which is known to be associated with immune suppression and can manifest with skin lesions.

rejected.label: Herpes Simplex
rejected.why: Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus from an ulcer base

rejected.label: Angioedema
rejected.why: The presence of heaped-up margins on the ulcers is not typical for angioedema

rejected.label: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS)
rejected.why: While the patient's immune status is improving, IRIS does not directly explain the specific skin manifestations
